author: KrustyKrew
name: Overwatch
short: Overwatch stat cards, rank-up alerts, party tools and a spray-challenge board.
description: Links BattleTags and pulls stats from the unofficial OverFast API: profile cards with ranks and top heroes, per-hero cards, head-to-head compares, server leaderboards, automatic rank-up announcements, the current meta, random hero/team rolls and map picks. Plus a spray-challenge board with a picture of everyone's collection and a tick-box editor.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Overwatch! Link with `[p]ow link Name#1234`, set announcements with `[p]owset channel #channel`, and load the cute sprays with `[p]ow challenge seedcute`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the BattleTag you choose to link, the OverFast player id derived from it, your last-seen competitive ranks (for rank-up alerts), and, per server, the spray-challenge IDs you mark complete. Use [p]ow unlink to remove your link, or the bot's [p]mydata commands to delete all stored data.
